name: Serralves em Festa
description: The cultural heart of the city beats loudest here this weekend. Dive into 50 uninterrupted hours of contemporary art, from major exhibitions and installations to dance, music, and street theatre.
longDescription:
Serralves em Festa is an annual cultural event hosted by the Serralves Foundation, transforming its park and museum into a continuous platform for contemporary artistic expression. The festival aims to make art accessible to a broad public, showcasing a diverse program that spans visual arts, performance, and sound. It is a key fixture in Porto's cultural calendar, reflecting the institution's commitment to fostering engagement with modern and contemporary art forms.

For 50 consecutive hours, visitors can explore a range of artistic disciplines across the extensive grounds of Serralves Park and within the museum buildings. The atmosphere is one of continuous discovery, with opportunities to encounter live music, dance performances, theatrical interventions, and site-specific installations. The event attracts a wide audience, from families to art enthusiasts, all engaging with the varied program in an outdoor and indoor setting.

Serralves em Festa is free to attend, welcoming walk-in visitors throughout its duration. The Serralves Park & Museum is located in Porto and can be reached by public transport; specific bus routes serve the area. The venue is generally accessible, with pathways throughout the park and ramps/lifts within the museum buildings.
